title: DNase-chip: A High Resolution Method to Identify DNaseI Hypersensitive Sites using Tiled Microarrays
protocol: Wash extensively in T4 DNA Polymerase Buffer (+DTT), 3 x 50mls for 1 hour each (to get rid of EDTA in plug).

Remove all liquid from 50 ml conical tube and add polymerase mix: 80 μl DNA plug (low melt gel); 12 μl 10x Polymerase Buffer (NEB#2); 5 μl dNTPs (10uM; NEB Cat # M0203L); 6 μl T4 DNA Polymerase; 99.2 μl H2O; 2 μl BSA (100x).
Incubate at room temperature for 3-4 hours (gently mix every hour or so).
Add plug to 500 μl TE.
Heat to 65°C for 10 minutes (flick every couple of minutes to dissolve agarose).
Add 1/10 volume 3M NaOAc, 2 volumes ETOH, and 1 μl glycogen (Roche Cat# 901393).
Place in freezer for at least 30 minutes.
Spin 15 minutes at 4°C and wash 1x with 70% ETOH.
Remove, quick spin, and remove remainder of liquid.
Air dry for 5 minutes (NO LONGER!).
Resuspend in 40 μl TE.

Incubate 2 μg DNA, 10 μl 5x Ligase Buffer (use wide bored tips; Invitrogen cat # 46300-018), 6.7 μl Annealed linkers (102B/103A; THIS IS OLIGO SET A... THAW LINKERS ON ICE), 0.5 μl T4 ligase (NED Cat # M0202L), H2O to 50 μl at 16°C overnight.
Shear DNA by adding ligation to 1.5 ml TE in a 15 ml conical tube.
Place the tube on ice and sonicate for 25 second pulses, with the tip almost at the bottom of the tube without movement, using setting 3 (sonicate while tube is in an ice bath).
Pulse each sample 8 times, cooling the sonicator tip with an ice bath after each round.
Use 100 μl of beads per reaction for binding to Streptavidin beads.
Wash beads 3 times with 1 ml of binding/wash buffer (TE plus 1M NaCl).
Add 300 μl of 5M NaCl to the sonicated DNA to achieve a final concentration of 1M NaCl.
Add 100 μl of beads to the sonicated DNA.
Rock the mixture for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Capture biotinylated ends using a magnet.
Wash the beads 3 times with 1 ml of binding/wash buffer (TE plus 1M NaCl).
Resuspend beads in blunt-ending mix (details in next section).

Incubate a mixture containing 97.3 μl H2O, 11 μl T4 Buffer (NEB buffer 2), 1 μl 10mM dNTPs (Roche #11814362001), 0.2 μl T4 DNA Polymerase (NEB Cat# M0203L), and 0.5 μl 100x BSA for 1 hour at 16°C, resuspending the beads once during incubation.
Wash beads 3 times with 1 ml of binding/wash buffer (TE plus 1M NaCl).
Resuspend beads in 50 μl ligation mix.
Mix 32.8 μl H2O, 10 μl 5x Ligase Buffer, 6.7 μl Annealed linkers, and 0.5 μl T4 Ligase.
Add the mix directly to beads and resuspend.
Incubate at 16 degrees overnight (resuspend beads once during incubation).
Wash 3 times with 1 ml of binding/wash buffer (TE plus 1M NaCl).
Resuspend pellet in 50 μl TE pH 8.0.
Mix 32.5 μl H2O, 4 μl 10x ThermoPol Buffer, 1.25 μl dNTPs, 1.25 μl oligo OJW102, and 1 μl beads.
Place the mixture in a PCR machine and heat up to 50 degrees Celsius, then hold and add 0.5 μl Taq DNA Polymerase, 8.5 μl H2O, and 1 μl ThermoPol Buffer.

Cycle using the following conditions: 55 cycles of 4 min each (add Taq at this stage - hot start), followed by 72 x 3 min, then 95 x 2 min, then 25 cycles of (95 x 30 sec, 60 x 30 sec, 72 x 1 min) and finally 72 x 5 min.
Add 400 μl TE to the PCR product.
Perform a phenol/chloroform extraction using phase locks 2.0 ml.
Precipitate with ethanol and add 1 μl glycogen.
Resuspend pellet in 25 μl TE.
Clean up on ArrayIT columns microarray probe purification kit.
Elute with 50 μl water.
Quantitate the eluted probes.
Label the probes for hybridization.
Hybridize the labeled probes to arrays.
Anneal primers by mixing 50 μl Tris-HCl 1M, pH 7.6; 375 μl of 40 μM oJW102; 375 μl of 40 μM oJW103 and 200 μl H₂O.
Place the mix in boiling water, then shut off heat and allow oligos to sit until room temperature is reached.
Put the annealed primers at 4 degrees overnight.
Aliquot the annealed primers and store at -20°C.
Thaw annealed primers on ice before use.
